title: Google\Cloud\Trace\V2\Span\TimeEvent\MessageEvent
name: MessageEvent
description: An event describing a message sent/received between Spans.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.type
params.description: Type of MessageEvent. Indicates whether the message was sent or received.

params.name: data.id
params.description: An identifier for the MessageEvent's message that can be used to match SENT and RECEIVED MessageEvents. It is recommended to be unique within a Span.

params.name: data.uncompressed_size_bytes
params.description: The number of uncompressed bytes sent or received.

params.name: data.compressed_size_bytes
params.description: The number of compressed bytes sent or received. If missing assumed to be the same size as uncompressed.
